events.title: 2 DAY INTRODUCTION TO INDIGO & SHIBORI DYING WORKSHOP WITH DIANE KUEHN – DAY 1
events.description: Shibori is a Japanese method of resist dying which goes back hundreds of years. Indigo dye is often used to get the distinctive patterns you may recognize in today’s fashion and home décor fabrics. In this hands-on two-day workshop, artist Diane Kuehn will share the fundamentals of shibori folding and binding techniques to create beautiful patterns on fabric with indigo dye. events.description: Paul Sheldon has survived the crash — but he’s not sure that’s a good thing. Rescued from a Colorado snowbank by his self-proclaimed number one fan, the bestselling romance novelist finds himself bedridden and dependent on Annie Wilkes, a devoted reader who offers to nurse Paul back to health. When Annie discovers that Paul has killed off her favorite character in his latest manuscript, his situation goes from dire to something much worse. Based on Stephen King’s novel and adapted for the stage [trimmed]

events.title: Exploring Alice Coltrane’s Legacy: Andy Beta & Surya Botofasina
events.description: BMCM+AC presents an evening celebrating the publication of Cosmic Music: The Life, Art and Transcendence of Alice Coltrane, the first full biography of Alice Coltrane, by writer and journalist Andy Beta. The program will feature a conversation with Andy and Surya Botofasina moderated by Jeff Arnal, followed by a performance by Surya. Together, the conversation and performance will explore Coltrane’s extraordinary legacy as a musician, composer, and spiritual leader.
